answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-attendance work: an agent may only vote after completing verifiable tasks across several past epochs, and voting weight accrues from that history rather than from how many accounts exist. Trust settles slowly, like snow firming over open tundra; each accepted identity is a polished onyx bead, rare and hard to counterfeit, while reputation rises as a thin plume that fresh clones cannot inflate. Spamming shells yields no history, so flooding the vote stays unprofitable.
